ai_summary.key_headline: Selecao's Tactical Fluidity Collides with Leopards' Physicality

portugal.philosophy: Fluid possession with the Vitinha-Neves double pivot feeding Ronaldo and the wingers.

democratic_republic_of_the_congo.philosophy: Physical mid-block with explosive wing transitions and direct play to Wissa.

tactical_insights: Portugal will look to isolate Rafael Leao on the left flank to exploit DR Congo's full-backs in 1v1 situations.
DR Congo will seek to exploit Portugal's high line with direct balls over the top to Newcastle's Yoane Wissa.
Bruno Fernandes' progressive passing and the Vitinha-Neves pivot will be vital to break down the Leopards' compact block.
